artifact.name: Z-Girl Director-Supervised Professional Network Visual Resilience Pass

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio AI Production Director v1 / shared-product-improvement-v1
review.notes: Director-supervised continuation from the current production baseline. Migrates Professional Support Network counselor, educator, family, and mentor photography from direct browser third-party dependencies to the existing governed /api/visual/[role] delivery layer. The prior syntax regression was caught by Verify Release and repaired before merge. No new source of truth, media stack, clinical capability, credential activation, provider marketplace, paid network function, or independent public-release authority is introduced.

ai_uses.purpose: Director-led production-state recovery, root-cause visual resilience remediation, CI defect detection and repair, governance verification, and release-candidate preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: The Production Director reuses the established resilient visual architecture so the Professional Network recruitment experience is less vulnerable to broken direct third-party image delivery, while CI prevents a syntax regression from reaching production.
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains public-release authority; professional/clinical boundaries, credential issuance, provider economics, participant-controlled sharing, canon changes, and approved-master replacement remain human-governed.
ai_uses.provenance: lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach PR #57 on factory/director-professional-network-resilience; supervised under the existing Greene Media Studio shared-product-improvement-v1 Director profile.

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: The remediation reuses deterministic governed delivery and existing CI; regulated, professional, consent, credential, and release decisions remain gated.

evidence: Professional Network human-centered visual surfaces now use the governed resilient delivery path rather than direct browser dependence on third-party image hosts.
Counselor, educator, family, and mentor imagery retains explicit semantic role mappings.
The existing Production Director is reused to identify and remediate a systemic visual reliability issue without creating a parallel media architecture.
CI identified the syntax regression before production and the Director cycle repaired it.
Reliable human-centered imagery reinforces that Z-Girl supports preparation for real professional and human relationships rather than replacing them.
No participant health, safeguarding, clinical-record, or private-reflection data capability is added.
Professional Network visual references use the existing /api/visual/[role] delivery architecture.
The syntax regression detected by Verify Release was repaired before merge and the candidate is re-running release verification.
Professional Network imagery retains descriptive alt text and responsive presentation.
The recruitment, credential, and participant-handoff information remains available as text independent of imagery.
Existing Z-Girl human-first professional-support doctrine and product repository remain authoritative.
No duplicate Director, canon registry, source of truth, professional network, or visual system was created.
Pre-activation language and owner gates are preserved.
Provider matching, booking, clinical records, paid network functions, clinical judgment, credential issuance, and professional license verification remain outside this release candidate.

exceptions: PR #57 requires successful Verify Release, Premium + AI Impact Gate, and rendered preview verification before merge.
Public release and any professional/clinical/credential/provider activation remain separately governed.
